messages:
maria: quick heads-up — proposing a soft pin of runtime v3.2.1 for the llama3x model family. seeing sporadic kernel mismatch in longseq workloads, hitting kv-cache invalidation. attaching notes below :warning:

dev-deploy-bot: scheduled action created: `pin runtime v3.2.1 -> llama3x`

ryan: timeline? is this blocking the nightly canary or just low-volume tails? :eyes:

maria: not blocking main canary yet, but observed degradation at >4k tokens on a small cohort. plan: soft pin for 6h window, run targeted smoke tests, then decide to lift or extend.

ana: SDK compatibility check — do we need a shim? which SDK versions are affected?

hao: SDK 2.6 and earlier use the old KV call path; 2.7 includes the small hotfix for the kernel handshake. customers on SDK 2.6 may see truncated responses if routed to unpinned runtime.

luke: for release notes: we should call out "temporary runtime pin to mitigate long-sequence kernel mismatch; recommended SDK >=2.7". Also add guidance for Dedicated customers.

maria: agreed. proposed RN blurb: "Temporary routing pin to runtime v3.2.1 for llama3x models to mitigate long-sequence KV-cache mismatches; users on SDK <2.7 should upgrade to avoid truncated outputs. Expect reassessment after 6h: smoke and perf telemetry review."

ryan: cool. please include rollback plan in thread. if degradation increases, we'll backfill to v3.1.x and open a hotfix build. rollback steps: `deploybot rollback --target runtime=v3.1.9 --model-filter=llama3x` and alert on-call.

maria: added to runbook. testing checklist: 
1) run `smoke/longseq` suite against canary group A (50 requests)
2) validate latency p99 and token drop rate <0.1%
3) confirm no new OOMs in telemetry

ana: who owns customer comms if we keep pin >24h? CC @support-team?

luke: i'll draft a short note for accounts flagged in telemetry; support to review.

hao: small ops note — quantized variant q4b behaves fine; pin only needed for float16 kernels on v3.2 default. will annotate pinlist with variant tag `kernel=float16` to avoid overblocking.

maria: perfect — annotated pinlist: `llama3x: runtime=v3.2.1, kernel=float16, reason=kv-cache-mismatch, window=6h, telemetry=link://internal/telemetry/4391200123`

dev-deploy-bot: action queued: `deploybot pin add --model llama3x --runtime v3.2.1 --tag kernel=float16 --note "kv-cache mismatch" --duration 6h` — ETA 5m

ryan: ack from me. if p99 latency climbs >20% we'll trigger rollback immediately. set alert on `runtime.pin.latency_delta` at 15%.

maria: will monitor. i'll post back in this thread with results at +1h and +4h. thx all :thumbsup:

dev-deploy-bot: action executed: pin applied at 4391200180 by deploy-runner-03
